tools.name: aggregate_endpoint
tools.description: Get statistical aggregations for market analysis. Billed per aggregation returned. Aggregations: count, sum, mean, median, mode, min, max, quantile-10, quantile-25, quantile-40, quantile-60, quantile-75, quantile-80, quantile-85, quantile-90, quantile-95, quantile-99. Text and boolean fields only su

tools.name: auth_endpoint
tools.description: Check that an API key exists and is enabled. Does not bill per call. Returns api_key_authorized boolean. It does not check the key's maximum monthly spend or the unlimited plan's daily allowance, so another tool can still refuse a key that passes here.

tools.name: field_detail
tools.description: Describe fields by name: type, accepted filter values, its source column if it has one, filtered, aggregated or predicted, which expand set it belongs to, its price per home returned, and its full description. Does not bill per call. Coverage differs by country, and the server instructions say how t

tools.name: field_list
tools.description: List the name of every public property data field, one per line. Does not bill per call. Pass filter to list only the names that contain a piece of text, for example score_, demographic_, assessment, permit or expand_listing. Follow with field_detail for each field's type, accepted filter values, ag

tools.name: geocoding_endpoint
tools.description: Find properties near coordinates (reverse geocoding). Billed per field, per home returned. Required: latitude, longitude. Optional: radius (km), shape (circle/square). This endpoint has no country, province, city, community or address parameters. To narrow by place, put filters such as country_abbre

tools.name: location_endpoint
tools.description: Get the places Houski holds property data for, as a hierarchy of countries, provinces (or states or regions), cities and communities, with links and slugs. Billed per location returned, a small fraction of a cent each. This is the source of every country_abbreviation, province_abbreviation, city and

tools.name: map_endpoint
tools.description: Get map data: pins, clusters, or heatmaps. Billed per cluster or heatmap cell returned, or per field, per home returned for pins. Scope it with all four bbox coordinates or a polygon. With no place filter, the box or polygon may cover no more homes than one country holds. A call with neither must ca

tools.name: predict_endpoint
tools.description: Predict property values over time. Billed per predicted field, once for each date and each property. Required: property_id, start_date, fields. Find the property_id first with search_endpoint or properties_endpoint. Supports batch requests and parameter overrides for scenario testing.

tools.name: properties_endpoint
tools.description: Retrieve property data (hundreds of fields) with filtering, sorting, and expansion. Billed per field, per home returned: each selected field's price for each home that has a value for it, so a field with no value for a home is not billed. Always set select= to limit fields. For comparables, 'good' p

tools.name: search_api_documentation
tools.description: Access API documentation pages for filter syntax, field references, and endpoint details. Does not bill per call. Pass an unknown page to get the full list of pages back.

tools.name: search_endpoint
tools.description: Find property_id using fuzzy address matching. Billed per field, per home returned. Handles typos, abbreviations, partial addresses. Pass country_abbreviation to keep every match in one country. Use returned property_id with other endpoints for detailed data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "auth_endpoint" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
